internalGuideTitle.message: Extensions can't run on this page because of Chrome's security policy

internalPdfStep2.message: Open the downloaded file in Chrome and its address becomes file://.

internalPdfStep3.message: Open the popup again on that page and click Turn on for this page. (If needed, the file URL access guide appears once more.)

internalStep1.message: chrome:// pages, other extensions' pages and the Chrome Web Store are areas where Chrome blocks every extension from injecting scripts.

internalStep2.message: Open a regular web page that has math in a new tab. Turn on for this page works there.

internalStep3.message: In a hurry, you can copy the LaTeX and paste it directly into the input box at the top of this popup.

internalPdfNote.message: PDFs shown inside the browser are rendered by the built-in PDF viewer extension in an isolated iframe. No other extension can reach inside it.
